en-GB.title: Estate Planning and Real Estate
en-GB.summary: RED Level 2 lesson 040: Estate Planning and Real Estate.
en-GB.body: This localized RED Level 2 lesson develops practical competency in Estate Planning and Real Estate. It preserves the English lesson's central purpose: analyse how the decision interacts with financing, cash flow, equity, risk, taxes, legal structure, time horizon, management, and broader financial goals where applicable. Learners should test assumptions, consider downside scenarios, and verify jurisdiction-specific tax, lending, insurance, estate, employment, business, and legal rules with qualified local professionals. The lesson supports informed decision-making rather than recommending a particular property, financing method, or investment strategy.
